title: Glowing pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#88eeff" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#88eeff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bladeGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b0f0ff"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#66ddff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#33bbee"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="handleGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff88cc"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#dd44aa"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="45" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Scissors open, pointing up-right -->
  <g transform="rotate(-30 50 50)">
    <!-- Bottom blade -->
    <path d="M48 52 L85 20 L88 26 L52 56 Z" fill="url(#bladeGrad)" stroke="#99eeff" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Top blade -->
    <path d="M52 48 L85 80 L88 74 L52 44 Z" fill="url(#bladeGrad)" stroke="#99eeff" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Screw / pivot -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="4" fill="#ffdd44" stroke="#ffee88" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- Bottom handle -->
    <path d="M44 54 C30 62 20 72 22 82 C24 92 38 92 44 82 C48 76 48 66 46 56 Z" 
          fill="url(#handleGrad)" stroke="#ffaadd" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- Handle hole bottom -->
    <ellipse cx="33" cy="76" rx="6" ry="8" fill="#33112a"/>

    <!-- Top handle -->
    <path d="M56 46 C70 38 80 28 78 18 C76 8 62 8 56 18 C52 24 52 34 54 44 Z" 
          fill="url(#handleGrad)" stroke="#ffaadd" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- Handle hole top -->
    <ellipse cx="67" cy="24" rx="6" ry="8" fill="#33112a"/>

    <!-- Blade edge highlights -->
    <line x1="50" y1="40" x2="80" y2="24" stroke="#eeffff" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="60" x2="80" y2="76" stroke="#eeffff" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  </g>
</svg>
